title: From Chatting to Building: How Modern AI Actually Works
subtitle: Edit by prompt, answer with facts — the two skills behind today's AI
intro: You saved a tombstone for DaVinci Resolve and a creator who cloned himself with HeyGen for 50M+ views. You can now edit video just by chatting.
takeaway: AI is powerful when it can edit with prompts and answer with retrieved facts, not just memory.

sections.heading: An everyday analogy: the helpful intern
sections.body:
Think of AI like a new intern.

The intern follows instructions like "cut the silences" very fast. A RAG model is an intern who can also look things up in company files before answering.

RAG means Retrieval-Augmented Generation. It retrieves documents first, then generates an answer from them.

sections.heading: Why does this exist? From prompts to trusted answers
sections.body:
Prompt-based video editing means no timeline needed. You type "make an avatar say this" and tools like HeyGen make the video with voiceover and translation.

RAG means the AI doesn't guess from memory. It searches your data, then answers. An RAG Agent does this search-and-answer loop by itself to finish tasks.

sections.heading: What can go wrong? When the intern gets it wrong
sections.body:
Three things can go wrong:
- Bad retrieval: wrong file means wrong answer.
- Bad prompt: "make it better" is too vague. Be specific.
- No checking: avatar clones or auto-cuts can look fake.

Fix it with good files, clear prompts, and a human check.

steps.narration: You start by chatting instead of clicking timelines.
Prompt tools translate chat to edits, like HeyGen cloning.
For facts, RAG retrieves documents first.
An agent generates the final video or answer.

quiz.q: What does RAG do differently from a normal chatbot?
options: It only works on Jetson Nano
quiz.why: RAG = Retrieval-Augmented Generation: retrieve first, then generate with those facts.

quiz.q: What fails first if usage grows 100x?
options: Retrieval: wrong or slow files lead to wrong answers
quiz.why: At scale, bad retrieval is the first break - if search fails, the answer fails.

quiz.q: Which prompt is better for AI video editing?
options: Remove silences from 0:10-0:15 and add captions
quiz.why: Clear, specific prompts give predictable edits; vague prompts give random results.
